# Pick My Secret Santa: full page text

> Complete text of pickmysecretsanta.com's three pages: the homepage (the draw tool and the reveal view), Privacy, and Terms.
> Pick My Secret Santa is a free Secret Santa draw tool. Add names and a budget. It draws matches in secret, right in your browser.
> Each person gets a private link with their match, plus six gift ideas inside the budget. A private link is hidden from plain sight, not locked; anyone with a link can open it.
> Gift ideas come from a fixed list of 212 ideas. No ads, no accounts, no store links.
> Text captured from the shipped pages, 2026-10-30.
> Contact: hello@pickmysecretsanta.com


## Page: https://pickmysecretsanta.com/

Pick My Secret Santa — Draw names in secret, get a gift idea
Pick My Secret Santa
Draw Secret Santa names in secret.
Free, no sign-up. Add names and a budget. About 2 minutes.
Start your draw
How it works
Add every name.
We draw in secret.
Send each private link.
What we don't do
We don't keep your group's names or matches on a server. The draw runs in your browser, and nothing you type is saved anywhere.
We don't email or text the matches for you. You send each person their own link.
We don't show one master list of who got whom. Each match lives only inside its own private link.
We don't sell gifts or take a cut. The gift ideas are suggestions only.
Our guarantees
No accounts and no email needed. The full draw is free, right in the page.
Our server never sees your names or your matches — so there is nothing here to sell or share.
There are no ads on this site.
Why it stays secret
The draw runs in your browser. Nothing is sent or saved. Each link shows one match only.
Run it step by step
1. Name your group and pick a budget.
2. Add every name, plus what each person likes.
3. Mark any pairs who must not draw each other.
4. Tap Draw the names. The draw runs here.
5. Send the group message first. It shares the rules.
6. Send each person only their own private link.
7. Open your own link last, like everyone else.
Your screen shows names and links. Never the matches.
Your link opens behind a cover screen first.
Peek shows only your match, your budget, your ideas.
Six gift ideas for each person
Gift ideas come from 212 real ideas. The same ideas as The Present Picker. Each person gets six ideas. Every idea fits your budget.

Keep it secret.
Give it without giving yourself away
Leave it on their desk while they are out.
Leave it at their door before they come home.
Leave it in a shared spot they check daily.
Leave it with the front desk or mail room.
Ask a friend who is not playing to deliver it.
Mail it in a plain box, no return name.
Hide it, then send a clue to find it.
Use plain wrap. Print the tag. Handwriting gives you away.
When you swap gifts
Let each person guess their Santa first.
Open one gift at a time, in turns.
Read the tag clue aloud before each guess.
Put a signed note inside the wrapping paper.
Tell everyone at once after the last gift.
A Santa can stay secret if they want.
This link does not work.

## Page: https://pickmysecretsanta.com/privacy

Privacy - Pick My Secret Santa
Pick My Secret Santa
Privacy
The short version:
Names and the draw stay in your browser. Cloudflare Web Analytics counts visits here. There are no accounts here.
What the draw does
You type names, a budget, and any pairs who should not draw each other.
The draw math runs in your browser.
Nothing you type is sent to us.
Nothing you type is saved anywhere.
It clears when you close the page.
Private links
Each link holds one person's match.
The match sits inside the link itself.
Our server never sees the match.
A link is hidden from plain sight, not locked.
Anyone with a link can open it.
Send each link only to its person.
You share links with your own apps.
Sharing starts only when you tap a button.
How visits are counted
This site loads Cloudflare Web Analytics.
It sends page and performance counts to Cloudflare.
Cloudflare says its beacon uses no cookies.
Children
Adults run the draws on this site.
Some gifts here are for children.
It is not directed at children under 13.
Contact
Questions about privacy: hello@pickmysecretsanta.com.
Changes
Changes will appear on this page.

## Page: https://pickmysecretsanta.com/terms

Terms - Pick My Secret Santa
Pick My Secret Santa
Terms
These terms cover this website only.
This site is a free Secret Santa tool.
You add names and a budget.
It draws matches and suggests gifts.
There are no ads on this site.
There are no accounts or sign-ups.
The site sells nothing at all.
How the draw works
The draw is random, with two rules.
Nobody draws their own name.
Pairs you mark never draw each other.
The draw runs in your browser.
We never see your group's matches.
Some rule sets cannot form a draw.
The site will say so when that happens.
Where gift ideas come from
Gift ideas come from a fixed list.
The list holds 212 gift ideas.
Your budget is a hard filter.
A gift hint raises matching ideas.
Budget bands are guides, not exact prices.
Stores set real prices, and prices change.
Buying your gift
This site links to no stores.
It takes no payment from you.
It places no orders for you.
You choose where and what to buy.
Check each idea before you buy.
Accounts and data
Names and draws stay in your browser.
Cloudflare Web Analytics counts visits here.
See the
Privacy page
for full details.
No guarantees
This site is provided as is.
We give no warranty of any kind.
We cannot guarantee any gift outcome.
We are not liable for any loss.
Fair use
Use this site only for lawful purposes.
Do not try to break this site.
We may change or stop this site.
Contact
Questions about terms: hello@pickmysecretsanta.com.
Changes
Changes will appear on this page.
